data.text:
Inbox item inb_660c21ae: a meeting from "customer call, Nov 13".
Triage it: pull out every ask it holds and record them with one triage_inbox call. Do not start threads, set the goal or plan today; the person promotes work from the backlog.
---
Customer call with Dana Reyes, finance lead at Northwind Supply, Nov 13.
Dana: At month end our accountant exports every task to a spreadsheet for the books. Right now she copies them out by hand.
Dana: A CSV export of all tasks with id, customer, amount, status and due date would save her most of a day.
Mihajlo: What counts as done for you?
Dana: She opens the file and sees one row per task under a header row, and names like "Acme, Inc." stay in one column.
Dana: Second thing: nobody notices when a task goes overdue. We'd like a list of every sent task past its due date, so someone can chase it the next morning.
Dana: And honestly the tasks page just feels slow and clunky.
Mihajlo: Thanks, I'll take these back to the team.
